1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 15 m de altura, de copa frondosa y redondeada, hojas duras, flores fragantes blancas y violetas y fruto rojizo; su corteza es usada en la medicina tradicional y como condimento. Canellaceae Canella winterana.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree reaching heights of up to 15 meters, with a dense and rounded crown, hard leaves, fragrant white and purple flowers, and reddish fruit; its bark is used in traditional medicine and as a spice. Canellaceae Canella winterana.
